vsm2.17:140.1:
From happy to happy destiny.

140. In the case of one in a happy destiny who has stored up blameless kamma, for it is said, “Then the good
deeds he did in the past … cover him and overspread him and envelop him” (M III 171), and so on.
vsm2.17:140.2:
when he is lying on his death-bed, his blameless kamma according as it has been stored
up, or its sign, comes into focus in the mind door.
vsm2.17:140.3: And that applies only in the case of one who has stored up blameless sense-sphere kamma.
vsm2.17:140.4: But in the case of one who has stored up kamma of the exalted spheres only the sign of the kamma comes into focus.
vsm2.17:140.5:
Then next to the cognitive series of impulsions ending in registration, or of simple impulsions,
that arose contingent upon that kamma or its sign,
vsm2.17:140.6: death consciousness arises making the life-continuum’s objective field its object.
vsm2.17:140.7: When it has ceased, rebirth-linking consciousness arises contingent upon that same kamma or sign of kamma that had come into focus,
vsm2.17:140.8: and it does so located in the happy destiny, being driven there by the force of defilements that have not been cut off.
vsm2.17:140.9:
This is the kind of rebirth-linking that has a past or a not-so-classifiable
object and comes next to death consciousness with a past object.
vsm2.17:141.1: 141. In another’s case, owing to blameless sense-sphere kamma,
vsm2.17:141.2:
there comes into focus in the mind door at the time of death the sign of a happy destiny, in other words,
the appearance of the mother’s womb in the case of the human world or the appearance of pleasure groves,
divine palaces, wishing trees, etc., in the case of the divine world.
vsm2.17:141.3: His rebirth-linking consciousness arises next to the death consciousness in the order shown for the sign of an unhappy destiny.
vsm2.17:141.4: This is the kind of rebirth-linking that has a present object and comes next to death consciousness with a past object.
vsm2.17:142.2:
or a sound as object, perhaps, preaching of the Dhamma, offerings of music,
etc.; or an odour as object, perhaps incense, scents, perfumes, etc.;
vsm2.17:142.3:
or a taste as object, perhaps honey, molasses, etc., saying, “Taste this, dear, it is a gift to be given for your sake”; or a
tangible datum as object, perhaps Chinese silk, silk of Somāra, saying, “Touch this, dear, it is a gift to be given for your sake.”
vsm2.17:142.4:
Now, when that visible datum, or whatever it may be, as object has come into focus for him and the consciousnesses
ending in determining have arisen in due succession,
vsm2.17:142.5: there arise in him impulsions numbering five because of slowing down due to the nearness of death, and two registrations;
vsm2.17:142.6: after that, one death consciousness, making the life-continuum’s objective field its object.
vsm2.17:142.7: At the end of that, having that same object, which lasts only a single conscious moment, rebirth-linking consciousness arises.
vsm2.17:142.8: This also is the kind of rebirth-linking with a present object and comes next to a death consciousness with a past object.
vsm2.17:143.1:
143. But in the case of another who is in a happy destiny and has obtained exalted
consciousness through earth-kasiṇa jhāna, etc., at the time of his death
vsm2.17:143.2:
there comes into focus at the mind door the sense-sphere profitable kamma or the sign of the kamma or the sign
of the destiny, or else the sign of the earth kasiṇa, etc., or else the exalted consciousness,
vsm2.17:143.3: or else there comes into focus a superior object of the eye or ear that is a cause for profitable rebirth.
vsm2.17:143.4:
When the consciousnesses ending in determining have arisen in due succession, there arise in him
impulsions numbering five because of slowing down due to the nearness of death.
vsm2.17:143.5:
But in those who belong to an exalted destiny there is no registration. So the one death consciousness
arises next to the impulsion and making the life-continuum’s objective field its object.
vsm2.17:143.6:
At the end of that, rebirth-linking consciousness arises located in one of the happy
destinies of the sense sphere or exalted sphere,
vsm2.17:143.7: and having as its object whichever one among the aforesaid objects has appeared.
vsm2.17:144.1:
This is the kind of rebirth-linking with a past, present, or not-so-classifiable object next to death
consciousness in a happy destiny with a not-so-classifiable object.
vsm2.17:144.2: 144. Rebirth-linking next to immaterial-sphere death should be understood in this way too.
vsm2.17:144.3:
This is how rebirth-linking occurs with a past, present, or not-so-classifiable object next to death
consciousness in a happy destiny with a past or not-so-classifiable object.
vsm2.17:145.1:
From unhappy to unhappy destiny.

145. In the case of one in an unhappy destiny who is an evil-doer, that kamma, or its sign,
or the sign of the destiny, comes into focus in the mind door,
vsm2.17:145.2: or in the five doors, as the object that is the cause for the unprofitable rebirth.
vsm2.17:145.3:
Then his rebirth-linking consciousness arises in due succession at the end of the death
consciousness and located in the unhappy destiny and with one of those objects as its object.
vsm2.17:145.4: This is how rebirth-linking occurs with a past or present object next to death in an unhappy destiny with a past object.
vsm2.17:146.1:
How Kamma is a Condition

146. Up to this point there has been shown the occurrence of the nineteenfold consciousness as rebirth-linking.
vsm2.17:146.2:
Also all this is further classified; for

“While it occurs in linking thus,
It has a double class beside
Through kamma, and as mixed and not,
And is still further classified.”
vsm2.17:147.1: 147. When this nineteenfold kamma-resultant consciousness occurs thus in rebirth-linking, it does so by means of kamma in two ways;
vsm2.17:147.2:
for according to the way in which the kamma that generates it occurs, the kamma can be its condition
both as kamma condition acting from a different time and as decisive-support condition,
vsm2.17:147.3:
since this is said: “Profitable … and unprofitable kamma is a condition,
as decisive-support condition, for its result” (Paṭṭh I 167, 169).
vsm2.17:148.1: 148. It should be understood that when it occurs thus, its double class, etc., is mixed and not, and it is still further classified.
vsm2.17:148.2:
For example: though this type of consciousness occurs in one way only as rebirth-linking,
still it is twofold as divided into mixed and unmixed with materiality;
vsm2.17:148.3: it is threefold as divided according to sense-desire, fine-material, and immaterial becoming (M I 50);
vsm2.17:148.4: it is fourfold as egg-born, womb-born, putrescence- (moisture-) born, and of apparitional generation (M I 73);
vsm2.17:148.5: it is fivefold according to destiny (M I 73);
vsm2.17:148.6: it is sevenfold according to the stations of consciousness (D III 253),
vsm2.17:148.7: and it is eightfold according to the abodes of beings excluding non-percipient beings (see D III 263).
vsm2.17:149.2:
“The mixed is double, sexed and not,
And that with sex is double too;
The least decads the first has got
Respectively are three and two.”
vsm2.17:150.1:
150. The mixed is double, sexed and not: that rebirth-linking consciousness, which, leaving
aside the immaterial becoming, arises here mixed with materiality,
vsm2.17:150.2:
is twofold as “with sex” and “without sex,” because it arises in the fine-material sphere without the sex
called femininity faculty and masculinity faculty, and because—leaving aside the rebirth-linking of one born
as a eunuch—it arises in the sense-sphere becoming together with that twofold sex.
vsm2.17:150.3:
And that with sex is double too: there also that with sex is twofold because it
arises in association with either the female or the male sex.
vsm2.17:151.1:
151. The least decads the first has got respectively are three or two: together with the rebirth-linking
consciousness that is mixed with materiality and comes first in the pair “mixed and unmixed,”
vsm2.17:151.2:
there arise, at the least, the two decads (see 18.5f.) of physical basis and body, or else the three
decads of physical basis, body, and sex. There is no reducing the materiality below that.
vsm2.17:152.1:
152. But when that minimal amount arises in the two kinds of generation termed egg-born and womb-born,
it amounts to no more than a drop of cream of ghee on a single fibre of new-born kid’s wool,
vsm2.17:152.2: and it is known as the “embryo in the first stage” (S I 206).
vsm2.17:153.1: 153. Herein, how the different kinds of generation come about may be understood according to the kind of destiny.
vsm2.17:153.2:
For as regards these:

“No first three generations are
In hell, or with the deities,
Save those of earth; all four are found
In the three other destinies.”
vsm2.17:154.1:
154. Herein, by the words with deities it should be understood that, as in hell and among deities—excepting earth
deities—so also among the ghosts consumed with thirst, the first three kinds of generation are not found;
vsm2.17:154.3:
But in the remaining three kinds of destiny, in other words, among animals, ghosts and human
beings, and among the earth deities excepted above, there are all four kinds of generation.
vsm2.17:155.2:
“The fine material gods have thirty-nine;
The apparitional and moisture-born
Have seventy material instances
At most, and they have thirty at the least.”
vsm2.17:156.1:
156. Firstly, among the fine-material Brahmās of apparitional generation there arise
together with rebirth-linking consciousness thirty and also nine material instances with the four groups,
namely, the decads of the eye, ear, and physical basis, and the ennead of life.
vsm2.17:156.2:
But leaving the fine-material Brahmās aside, among the others of apparitional generation and those of the moisture-born generation
there are seventy instances of materiality at the most with the decads of the eye, ear, nose, tongue, body, physical basis and sex.
vsm2.17:156.3: And these are invariably to be found among deities of the sense sphere.
vsm2.17:156.4:
Now, the group of material states comprising the ten material instances, namely, colour, odour, flavour,
nutritive essence, and the four primary elements, with eye sensitivity and life, are called the “eye decad.”
vsm2.17:156.5: The remaining groups of material states should be understood in the same way.
vsm2.17:157.1:
157. At the least, thirty material instances arise with the decads of the tongue, body, and physical
basis, in those who are blind from birth, deaf, noseless, and sexless.
vsm2.17:157.2: Between the most and the least, the allotment should be understood according as appropriate.
vsm2.17:158.2:
“One ought to consider the pair death and birth
Under aggregates, object, cause, destiny, feeling,
Happiness, and then thinking applied and sustained,
Distinguishing them by unlikeness and likeness.”
vsm2.17:159.1:
159. The meaning is this: there is rebirth-linking that is twofold as mixed and unmixed with materiality, and there is the death
consciousness next before it, and their unlikeness and likeness according to these aggregates, etc., must be known.
vsm2.17:160.1: 160. Sometimes, next to a four-aggregate immaterial death there is a four-aggregate rebirth-linking having a like object;
vsm2.17:160.2: sometimes there is an exalted rebirth-linking with an internal object next to an unexalted death with an external object.
vsm2.17:160.3: This, firstly, is the method in the case of the immaterial planes.
vsm2.17:160.4: Sometimes there is a five-aggregate sense-sphere rebirth-linking next to a four-aggregate immaterial death.
vsm2.17:160.5:
Sometimes there is a four-aggregate immaterial rebirth-linking next to a five-aggregate
sense-sphere death or fine-material-sphere death.
vsm2.17:160.6: Thus there is rebirth-linking with a present object next to a death with a past object,
vsm2.17:160.7: there is rebirth-linking in a certain unhappy destiny next to death in a certain happy destiny,
vsm2.17:160.8: there is rebirth-linking with root-cause next to root-causeless death,
vsm2.17:160.9: there is triple-root-cause rebirth-linking next to double-root-cause death,
vsm2.17:160.10: there is rebirth-linking accompanied by joy next to death accompanied by equanimity,
vsm2.17:160.11: there is rebirth-linking with happiness next to death without happiness,
vsm2.17:160.12: there is rebirth-linking with applied thought next to death without applied thought,
vsm2.17:160.13: there is rebirth-linking with sustained thought next to death without sustained thought,
vsm2.17:160.14:
there is rebirth-linking with applied and sustained thought next to death without applied and sustained
thought. In this way they can be coupled together by opposites as appropriate.
vsm2.17:161.1:
161. “A mere state that has got its conditions
Ushers in the ensuing existence;
While it does not migrate from the past,
With no cause in the past it is not.”
vsm2.17:162.1:
162. So it is a mere material and immaterial state, arising when it has obtained its conditions,
that is spoken of, saying that it comes into the next becoming; it is not a lasting being, not a soul.
vsm2.17:162.2: And it has neither transmigrated from the past becoming nor yet is it manifested here without cause from that.
vsm2.17:163.1: 163. We shall explain this by the normal process of human death and rebirth-linking.
vsm2.17:163.2:
When in the past becoming a man near to a natural or violent death is unable to bear the onset of the unbearable
daggers of the painful feelings that end in death as they sever the ligatures of the joints in all the limbs,
vsm2.17:163.3:
his body gradually withers like a green palm leaf lying in the glare of the sun, and when the faculties of the eye,
etc., have ceased and the body faculty, mind faculty, and life faculty remain on in the heart-basis alone,
vsm2.17:163.4:
then consciousness, which has as its support the heart-basis still remaining at that moment, either occurs
contingent upon some kamma classed as “weighty,” “repeated,” performed “near” to death or previously, in other
words, the formation that has obtained the remaining conditions,
vsm2.17:163.5: or contingent upon the objective field made to appear by that kamma, in other words, the sign of the kamma or sign of the destiny.
vsm2.17:163.6:
And while it is occurring thus, because craving and ignorance have not been abandoned, craving pushes it and the conascent
formations fling it forward on to that objective field, the dangers in which are concealed by ignorance.
vsm2.17:163.7:
And while, as a continuous process, it is being pushed by craving and flung forward by formations, it abandons
its former support, like a man who crosses a river by hanging on to a rope tied to a tree on the near bank,
vsm2.17:163.8:
and, whether or not it gets a further support originated by kamma, it occurs by means of the conditions
consisting only in object condition, and so on.
vsm2.17:164.1:
164. The former of these two states of consciousness is called “death” (cuti) because of falling (cavana), and the latter is called
“rebirth-linking” (paṭisandhi) because of linking (paṭisandhāna) across the gap separating the beginning of the next becoming.
vsm2.17:164.2:
But it should be understood that it has neither come here from the previous becoming nor has it become
manifest without the kamma, the formations, the pushing, the objective field, etc., as cause.
vsm2.17:165.1:
165. “An echo, or its like, supplies
The figures here; connectedness
By continuity denies
Identity and otherness.”
vsm2.17:166.1:
166. And here let the illustration of this consciousness be such things as an echo, a light,
a seal impression, a looking-glass image, for the fact of its not coming here from the previous
becoming and for the fact that it arises owing to causes that are included in past becomings.
vsm2.17:166.2:
For just as an echo, a light, a seal impression, and a shadow have respectively sound, etc.,
as their cause and come into being without going elsewhere, so also this consciousness.
